title: Rhymelight — Rap Complexity & Genius Song Lyrics
description: Local phonetic and complexity analysis with official Genius song-lyrics search and in-app lyrics preview via the IMPROVS2 Vercel proxy. Only song results are shown; community lists and annotations are excluded.

benchmarks.artist: Drake feat. Kanye West, Lil Wayne & Eminem

metrics.label: Rhyme density
metrics.description: Within-song phonetic syllable groups repeated across different word forms, divided by that song’s total syllables.

metrics.label: Multi-syllable rhymes
metrics.description: Distinct within-song repeated multisyllabic word endings and two-to-four-syllable line-ending sequences, normalised per 16 lines.

metrics.label: Internal rhymes
metrics.description: Within-song repeated phonetic rhyme syllables occurring before a line’s final syllable, normalised per 100 syllables.

metrics.label: Shared sounds
metrics.description: Phonetic rhyme sounds present in more than one selected song; reported separately from each song’s own complexity scores.

metrics.label: Pronunciation coverage
metrics.description: Share of words found in the bundled pronunciation dictionary.

pronunciation.variantPolicy: Primary pronunciation for each dictionary headword.
pronunciation.unknownWordPolicy: Keep the word visible, estimate syllable count from spelling, and do not invent a phonetic rhyme match.

lyricsPolicy: Only user-supplied lyrics are bundled. The official Genius API is called directly for song search, song metadata, annotated lyric fragments and attached annotations, using the user-provided Genius Client Access Token. Complete song lyrics are rendered by Genius’s own embed.js inside an isolated in-app iframe; Rhymelight does not scrape or reproduce full lyrics. No Lovable API, third-party lyrics API, or server proxy is used.

gradeModel.title: Weighted lyric complexity and artistry

components.label: Multisyllabic rhyming
components.method: Distinct repeated multi-syllabic phonetic patterns per 16 lines

components.label: Internal rhyme density
components.method: Repeated rhyme syllables inside lines per 100 syllables

components.label: Rhyme density
components.method: Share of syllables in repeated phonetic rhyme families

components.label: Flow and rhythmic complexity
components.method: Timed syllables/second, syllables/beat and stress variation; text rhythm proxy without duration

components.label: Wordplay and double meanings
components.method: User-rated 0–10; semantic interpretation is not automatically inferred

components.label: Metaphor and imagery
components.method: User-rated 0–10; semantic interpretation is not automatically inferred

components.label: Sustained complexity
components.method: Share of four-line blocks containing a recurring phonetic rhyme family

gradeModel.missingManualRatings: Excluded from active weight; grade is labelled provisional until all three manual ratings are entered.

durationSeconds.description: Exact duration of the passage entered above

gradeModel.tempoWarning: BPM alone is not a rap-speed measurement. Syllables per second requires passage duration; syllables per beat also requires BPM.
